name: VF-3000E
description:
## Description

"This VF (variable flux) type stereo cartridge was developed based on the results of R &ΩD and experience with the M-1007series and M-2000series announced by Micro-Seiki Co., Ltd. as the final version of MM type cartridge.We have succeeded in changing the cross-sectional area and shape of the cantilever in one piece for the first time in Japan by developing our own precision machining technology.The rear part of the cantilever is made into a rectangular column shape, and the vibrator is contained in it. The part which changes from the rectangular column shape to the cylindrical part is made into a conical shape, and a special curing process is applied on it.As a result, the cantilever can be regarded as one rigid body, and the pick-up force for sharp transients and large amplitude in low frequencies, which was difficult with conventional methods, has been improved.A twin damper system has been adopted for the damper part, and two types of damper materials with different hardness, viscosity, and elasticity have been successfully integrated at the molding stage without sticking together.Since this twin damper is a composite of two types of damper materials with different characteristics, special characteristics that cannot be obtained with conventional dampers can be obtained.Since the rear end of the conical cantilever is supported by a special twin damper, compliance is large, and changes in the vibrator can be extracted as changes in magnetic flux.In addition, along with the high compliance, the tracking ability to the sound groove of the needle tip is improved, and the resonance point in the high-frequency range can be raised.Natural diamond elliptical needle of 0.8mil long diameter and 0.3mil short diameter is used for the needle tip.The elliptical needle reduces the pinch effect distortion and tracing distortion compared to the round needle, realizes the characteristics of frequencies above 25kHz, and improves the channel separation in the high frequency range.Since the needle replacement is a plug-in method with a mold tip, it can be replaced with the same feeling as MM type.Since the screw holes conform to JIS and EIA standards, the tone arm based on this standard can be mounted as it is."

name: CD-M2000X
description:
## Description

"This CD player was developed based on the technology and know-how accumulated through analog players.Large rigidity is obtained by hollowing out and attaching solid aluminum high-speed steel of 15mm thickness for the front panel and 10mm thickness for the side panel to the minimum necessary outside of the aluminum die-cast chassis.A lead sheet is inserted between the bottom plate and bottom plate and the chassis to ensure sufficient mass for eliminating resonance. In addition, the tray mechanism and the top cover are provided with a ferrite vibration control sheet to suppress resonance and obtain a large effect.To minimize electromagnetic vibration from the transformer itself, the power supply section uses a short ring, a ham proof belt, and a copper-plated shield case to prevent magnetic flux leakage that may adversely affect other circuits.The secondary winding has three independent circuits for the digital circuit, analog circuit and display circuit to prevent interference between the circuits.Both the digital circuit board and the analog circuit board are completely shielded with a large copper plated cover to prevent the high frequency of the digital circuit from interfering with the analog circuit due to unnecessary radiation.A simple, all-IC balanced out circuit uses capacitors such as ERO and Telefunken, and PCOCC thick wires to achieve higher quality playback.The CFC panel is finished with satin, hairline treatment and titanium color.The side and top panels have a black rabbi paint.The legs have a highly stable 3-point layout, and a chrome plating finish is used for the pure brass removal.In addition, we have adopted a two way foot that can be used for both rigid type and pallet type depending on the condition of the place."

name: BL-101
description:
## Description

"This is an armless player that pursues higher perfection by introducing various technologies such as the direct coupling method which gained a reputation in RX 5000and BL 111.The vibration mode is thoroughly analyzed by the Structural Dynamic Analyzer, and Micro'Ωs unique direct coupling method is adopted. In this method, the shaft assembly of the turntable and the arm mount are completely integrated with the connecting frame, the vibration circulation system is in phase, and the turntable and the arm do not cause any phase shift due to vibration, enabling more accurate tracing.In addition, this integrated structure makes the vibration circulation system as short as possible and increases the rigidity, minimizing the conversion loss when the cartridge converts the vibration energy from the sound groove into an electric signal.The turntable section uses special aluminum for the main turntable (305mm diameter) and zinc for the sub turntable (180mm diameter), and adopts a double turntable system in which the surfaces are firmly joined by three screws.The joint surface has a flat surface by high-precision polishing which Micro boasts. This double structure dumps the main turntable'Ωs squeal and improves the playback sound by adding weight to the sub-turntable and increasing the moment of inertia.In addition to the conventional tapered connection method, a more reliable press-fit method has been adopted for connecting the sub-turntable and turntable shaft to clarify the fulcrum point.The bearing portion of the turntable shaft is 12mm longer in the radial direction than that of BL-91to eliminate play caused by clearance with the bearing.The 16mm diameter high rigidity shaft (stainless steel copper) is housed in a large bearing assembly and is an oil bath system filled with special synthetic oil.A strobe light is mounted on the back of the outer circumference of the main turntable and can be checked from the front by a reflecting mirror.Uses an insulator that takes external vibration and howling into consideration.The cabinet has a urethane finish with a natural wood tack plate finish.In addition, the dust cover is laminated with acrylic resin and adopts V-cut structure.One A-1200series is attached to the arm mount base."

description:
## Description

"A direct drive player with separate power transformer structure.The power transformer in which the power transformer is separated from the main body, S/N is improved by eliminating the influence of the power transformer.This outer power trans configuration reduces the effect of leakage flux to cartridges with poor shielding and low-power cartridges, resulting in clearer playback sound.Two AC outlets are arranged in this power supply.A 20pole, 60slot brushless DC servo motor has been adopted for the motor part to obtain excellent characteristics.The turntable has an inertial mass of 330kg Ï‰ cm.2It uses an aluminum die-cast large turntable. The density is equalized by the original casting method, and the deviation at 900revolutions by the balancing machine is kept within 2g. In addition, 315g and 1cm for rubber sheet.2High-density sheet of about 1.2g per sheet is used to prevent resonance.The tone arm adopts a universal type static balance type arm that uses the rotating part of MA-202as it is.High precision pivot and original angular type bearings are combined for the vertical bearings of the rotating part, and radial type bearings are used for the upper and lower points of the water plain bearing part to achieve an initial horizontal and vertical sensitivity of 10mg or less.The main weight for needle pressure adjustment is a one turn direct reading type between 0and 3g. By adjusting the horizontal balance of the arm and the needle pressure indicator to 0, the proper needle pressure of the used cartridge can be obtained correctly.A sub-weight (sold separately) can be attached to the rear.In order to check the horizontal balance of the arm depending on the height of the cartridge in use, it is equipped with a helicoidal arm height adjustment mechanism. This adjustment mechanism allows fine adjustment within 6mm.In addition, the cartridge is equipped with a variable inside for scan cellar that can handle the needle pressure. With the unique variable structure that can handle the needle pressure, the cancellation amount changes relative to the outer and inner surfaces of the record, so the imbalance of the needle pressure caused by the inside force can be eliminated and the tracing capacity of the cartridge is improved.The arm lifter has an oil dump-type delay operation to smooth the contact and release between the record surface and needle tip.The head shell uses H-202, an aluminum die cast head shell, and the connector pin is gold-plated to prevent contact failure. In addition, the head lock connector part at the tip of the arm is equipped with a head shell inclination adjusting screw to enable vertical adjustment.The rotational speed is changed electronically with a micro switch, and fine adjustment can be performed within ¥6% at each speed.The cabinet adopts a double structure of die-cast frame and solid base, and measures against howling are taken.In addition, by installing large absorbers on the legs, the effect of vibration is reduced. These absorbers are height adjustable.Equipped with a mirror-type strobe with a precision strobe placed behind the turntable.The output code is a low-capacitance type of 50pF/m, which reduces the influence on the high-frequency characteristics and supports 4-channel playback."

description:

name: SOLID-5
description:
## Description

"Belt drive type player with DC servo control.The mechanism section is equipped with a small DC servo motor, and constant speed rotation is obtained by controlling even a slight rotational deviation with the servo mechanism. The belt uses a neoprene belt with excellent material, hardness, and finish accuracy to improve constant speed rotation characteristics.The turntable is made of die-cast aluminum alloys, and the turntable shaft is made of 12� stainless steel. Bearings are made of gunmetal.In order to maintain stable characteristics of the motor unit, a large housing that is less affected by changes in external temperature is attached.A current limiting circuit is used in the power supply section to control the temperature of the motor itself even under transient load to the turntable.The tone arm uses the mechanism of the rotating part of MA-202.The vertical bearings of this tone arm use a combination of a highly accurate pivot and an original angular type bearing, and the water plain bearing section uses radial bearings at two points above and below, achieving an initial horizontal and vertical sensitivity of 10mg or less.In addition, it is equipped with a variable needle pressure inside four scan seller that improves the tracing ability of the cartridge.The main weight for needle pressure adjustment is a one turn direct reading type between 0and 3g. The appropriate needle pressure of the cartridge to be used can be obtained by adjusting the horizontal balance of the arm and the needle pressure indicator to 0. A sub weight is attached to the rear part.The output code uses a low-capacitance type of 50pf/m and is compatible with 4-channel playback.The arm lifter uses an oil dump type that makes contact and release between the record surface and needle tip smooth.In addition, there is a queuing guide pin that can easily adjust the height of the arm lifter.Die-cast H-303is used for the head shell. In addition, the head lock connector part can be vertically adjusted.The solid base that supports the mechanism of the player has been adopted after consideration from various aspects such as mass, flatness, and resonance. As a countermeasure against howling, compression homogen with low resonance point is adopted as a material to avoid unnecessary internal space.The switching mechanism of power ON / OFF, 331/3, 45rotation is an electronic type. Since there is no belt replacement, the influence on belt maintenance and rotation speed characteristics is reduced.33Each 1/3and 45rotation is equipped with an independent fine adjustment control, and adjustment of ¥6% is possible for the specified speed.The number of revolutions is checked with a strobe and neon lamp inscribed on the outer circumference of the turntable.Height-adjustable absorbers and levels allow horizontal adjustment of the player."
